description:
A parley-files FileSource implementation for SSH/SFTP servers, found at runtime through
		ServiceLoader. The SSH library is a provider found on the class path: parley-files-sftp-parley-ssh
		(parley-ssh), parley-files-sftp-jsch, parley-files-sftp-mina, or one written against the
		us.bringardner.parley.files.sftp.spi package. The tests jar is the suite every provider runs.
		Formerly us.bringardner:bjl_file_system_sftp.
